name: ballasted bed longitudinal resistance
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 有砟道床对轨道纵向移动的抵抗力。
usage_overview: 道床纵向阻力用于表征有砟道床对轨枕纵向移动的约束，可按每根轨枕所受阻力表示。在轮轨纵向相互作用分析中，可采用非线性关系描述这一约束。

complete_examples.text: Linear ballasted bed longitudinal resistance (when the sleeper displacement is zero); Case 2.
Finally, the influence of the track irregularity and the nonlinearity of the ballasted bed longitudinal resistance on the longitudinal response of the system are analyzed in detail.
